name: Robe of the Archmagi
description: A long robe of white, grey or black cloth worked with silver runes.
attuned_by: by a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
body:
## What it does

Worn without armor, it guards you as well as fine armor would, with your quickness counted in full. Spells and magic struggle to take hold of you, and your own spells are harder to resist and strike truer. The robe's colour follows its maker's outlook, and a wearer whose outlook clashes with it gains nothing.

advantages.name: Saving throws
advantages.note: against spells and other magical effects
